UPDATE posthog_person
        SET is_deleted = true,
            version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1,
            properties = '{}'::jsonb,
            properties_last_updated_at = '{}'::jsonb,
            properties_last_operation = '{}'::jsonb
        WHERE team_id = $1 AND id = ANY($2) AND is_deleted = false
